description: This file defines the 'AnyOf' class, which extends an abstract composite class and specifies a validation rule class from the Respect Validation library. It is part of the validation rules for the OrangeHRM Core API version 2, specifically within composite validation rules.

classes.name: AnyOf
classes.description: A validation rule class extending AbstractComposite to represent a composite 'any-of' validation rule in the OrangeHRM API.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the validation rule from the Respect Validation library that this class wraps, specifically the 'AnyOf' rule.
